'''Kolo Lovek''', also known by his nickname '''Kolo "Lightning" Lovek''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. After suffering a series of high-profile losses, Lovek came to suspect that his rivals had been sabotaging his [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bike.<ref name="Mission" />
